scope: Ten complete 240-epoch training runs, ten independent 4000-action confirmations, ten 8000-action continuations, and cross-checks against ten previously audited zero-shot evaluations. No GPU or checkpoint pickle execution during this audit.

screen.uncertainty: Sample SD (ddof=1), SE, and two-sided 95% Student-t mean intervals across independent training seeds. Null uncertainty for one seed. Evaluation episodes are averaged within each trained model, never counted as independent training seeds.

paired_vs_baseline.delta_definition: Candidate minus matched baseline; positive coverage is better.
